answer: Agents bind identity to RF line-of-sight attestations plus proof-of-location, so a sybil cannot fake the nectar of co-presence without distinct transceivers. Each new node must inherit trust through a fable of signed multi-hop vouchers, and consensus rejects identities lacking a verifiable ledge of prior link continuity. Duplicate sybils forfeit staked bonds and reputation, making forgery economically ruinous.
